MOTISONS.NS.d: Motisons Jewellers Ltd. is an Indian company that makes and retails jewelry, including bangles, necklaces, earrings, pendants, rings, chains and mangalsutras, in gold, diamonds, kundan, pearls, silver, platinum and gemstones. It also sells gold and silver coins, utensils and decorative items, and offers an online store alongside its physical shops.

NDLVENTURE.NS.d: NDL Ventures Limited operates in Indian real estate, mainly through its subsidiaries. It dates from 1985, is headquartered in Mumbai, and took its present name in April 2023, replacing Nxtdigital Limited.

NIRLON.NS.d: Nirlon Limited is involved in real estate development and industrial park operations. The company develops and manages commercial properties and industrial spaces. Nirlon Limited is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

NOVAAGRI.NS.d: Nova Agritech Limited, established in 2007, produces, distributes and sells agricultural inputs. Its products cover soil health, crop nutrition and crop protection, including bio-stimulants, bio-pesticides, integrated pest management systems and related agricultural technologies.

PERSISTENT.NS.d: Persistent Systems Limited provides software products, services, and technology solutions. The company operates through three segments: Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI), Healthcare & Life Sciences, and Technology Companies and Emerging Verticals.

RAMAPHO.NS.d: Rama Phosphates Limited supplies agricultural inputs, chemicals and soya-based products in India, with divisions for single super phosphate fertilizer, chemicals, power, soya and micro nutrients. Its fertilizers include powdered and granular SSP, NPK mixes and fortified products like boron- and zinc-enriched SSP, as well as micronutrients.

RELIGARE.NS.d: Religare Enterprises Limited operates as an investment company in India and internationally. The company provides broking services in equities, currencies, and commodities; depository participant services; and TIN and PAN facilities, as well as operates as an NSDL-appointed enrolment agency for Aadhaar unique identification number and an AMFI-registered mutual fund distributor.

RML.NS.d: Rane (Madras) Limited manufactures and sells auto components in India. It offers mechanical steering gears, hydrostatic steering systems, and steering and suspension linkage products; low porosity and high-quality aluminum die castings, such as steering housings and engine case covers; and high-pressure aluminum die-casting components. The company markets and sells its products to the manufacturers of passenger cars, utility vehicles, and farm tractors. It also exports its products.

SBGLP.NS.d: Suratwwala Business Group Limited builds residential, commercial and IT park properties in India and provides maintenance services for the properties it develops. It also rents out real estate, including space for mobile towers and hoardings, offers related real estate services, and installs and commissions solar power systems.

SIGMAADV.NS.d: Sigma Advanced Systems Limited currently has no significant operations. Earlier it worked in information technology in India, concentrating on pharma, aerospace and defence electronics. It was formerly Megasoft Limited and took its present name in January 2026. Incorporated in 1999, it is based in Hyderabad.

SOMICONVEY.NS.d: Somi Conveyor Beltings Limited manufactures and sells industrial conveyor belts in India and internationally. It provides general purpose, heat resistant, fire resistant, and oil resistant conveyor belts. The company also offers special purpose conveyor belts, such as bullet proof, chevron, rough top, pipe conveyor, and fusion belts, as well as rubber sheets and mattings, maintenances conveyor belts, and steel cord beltings. It primarily serves the cement, sponge iron, power, and mining sectors.

STALLION.NS.d: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Limited aggregates, blends and refines refrigerants and industrial gases in India. It supplies fluorochemicals including hydrocarbons, hydrofluorocarbons and hydrofluoroolefins, together with spare parts and equipment serving the refrigeration and air conditioning industry.

SURANI-SM.NS.d: Surani Steel Tubes Limited manufactures and supplies steel tubes and pipes. The company caters to various industries, including infrastructure, construction, and engineering. They are located in India.

TERASOFT.NS.d: Tera Software Limited provides IT and integrated related products and services worldwide. It operates through Integrated Solutions Division, Technical Division, and Projects Division segments. The company offers its services in various categories, such as system integration and networking, and software development and consultancy, as well as GST billing, invoicing, and filing software.

TICL.NS.d: Twamev Construction and Infrastructure Limited (TCIL) is an India-based company providing infrastructure development solutions. Its work includes highways, expressways, bridges, flyovers, tunnels, rail and metro systems, airports and terminals.

TPHQ.NS.d: Teamo Productions HQ Limited is an Indian engineering design firm focused on civil engineering and support services. It is also involved in the distribution of electrical power and energy, commodity trading, and information technology covering software development, and trades engineering goods such as steel components, electrical hardware and irrigation equipment.

UDS.NS.d: Updater Services Limited, founded in Chennai in 1985, is an Indian business services provider. It has two divisions: Integrated Facilities Management and Business Support Services. The facilities side covers housekeeping, cleaning, disinfection, pest control, landscaping and facade cleaning, as well as production support for factories such as material handling and warehouse management.

URJA.NS.d: Urja Global Limited engages in the design, consultancy, integration, supply, installation, commissioning, and maintenance of off grid and grid connected solar power plants and decentralized solar applications in India. It offers solar, e-rickshaw, automotive, and inverter batteries; solar inverters; LED street, flood, and panel lights, as well as LED bulbs and slim LED panel lights; PV modules; solar water heaters; solar lanterns; solar power packs; solar home lighting systems; and solar charge controllers.

UYFINCORP.NS.d: U. Y. Fincorp Limited is a non-banking financial company providing financial services. It mainly lends to corporates and individuals and invests and trades in securities, with fund-based services such as loans against shares and financing of industrial assets, real estate and infrastructure.

VEEDOL.NS.d: Veedol Corporation Limited, established in Kolkata in 1921 and formerly Tide Water Oil Co. (India) Limited, makes and distributes lubricants under the Veedol name, mainly in India. Its range serves automotive and industrial uses, with automotive oils for two-wheelers and passenger vehicles among others.

XPROINDIA.NS.d: Xpro India Limited produces and sells polymers primarily in India. The company offers bi-axially oriented polypropylene films for use in the packing of adhesive tapes, bakery products, biscuits, cigarette overwraps, confectionery, metalizing products, potato chips, print lamination products, processed foods, salted snacks, supermarket products, and others.

ZUARI.NS.d: Zuari Agro Chemicals Limited manufactures, trades in, and markets chemical fertilizers in India. It produces organic manure, micronutrients, seeds, pesticides, and specialty fertilizers; and DAP, ammonia, urea, and NPK A and NPK B fertilizers. The company is also involved in trading complex fertilizers, water soluble fertilizers, pesticides, and seeds. It markets its products under the Jai Kisaan brand to farmers through dealers.
